candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract; evidenced contract incompatibility changes the active lineage basis to anchor_policy while preserving one complete executable state. The third consumes that state and reopens only task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting closure, reopens only task and candidate_hypothesis, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Triggered Causal Re-root Relay
candidate_structure.organization: four-call sequential nonbranching executable lineage with contract-triggered causal re-root authority on the anchor-window edge

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, assess its causal basis against only the reentered anchor evidence, apply the contract-triggered lineage re-root transition when evidenced, and emit one complete executable policy state.
Consume anchor_causal_reroot_transition, reconcile the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered constraints and structural evidence, and emit one complete executable policy closure.
Consume constraint_window_transition, reconcile the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered task and hypothesis evidence, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion can revise an inherited artifact but cannot revoke its causal parentage when later evidence discredits its foundation.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: The mutation changes which artifact causally governs all downstream revisions, introducing revocable lineage ancestry rather than refining an existing review action.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: Downstream calls receive an anchor-rooted executable artifact after the trigger and can discard commitments that incremental reconciliation would preserve.
mode_certificate.state_transition: The active executable lineage changes from inherited-candidate continuation to anchor-rooted reconstruction without branching or losing policy executability.
mode_certificate.trigger: Reentered anchor evidence establishes that a foundational commitment of the inherited executable artifact is incompatible with the anchor contract.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Give the anchor-window edge authority to re-root the single executable lineage to the anchor policy when contract incompatibility is evidenced.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The lineage can escape unsupported early commitments while preserving one complete executable artifact and one sequential nonbranching path.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion preserves the originating capsule as the causal parent through every downstream reconciliation, even when reentered anchor evidence invalidates that inherited basis.

structural_mutation.after: The anchor-window transition changes the lineage parent to anchor_policy when reentered anchor evidence establishes contract incompatibility with the inherited basis.
structural_mutation.before: The anchor-window transition always reconciles evidence into the inherited capsule while preserving that capsule as the lineage parent.
structural_mutation.why_structural: This changes causal ancestry and rewrite authority on an existing edge rather than adding a reviewer, certificate, gate, field, role split, or rename.
